decision.title: fn:put, revalidation, untyped copies and the 4.0 return clause (packets 7.7b, 7.7c)

body.p: , after , , , , . The rest of the XQuery Update Facility after 7.7a: fn:put and revalidation (7.7c), the 4.0 draft's updating return clause (7.7b), and copies that drop schema identity.

item.p: fn:put (XQUF 3.0, 6.1; src/xquery_update.c): a row of XQuery's function table (src/xquery_load_module.c, beside fn:load-xquery-module), fn:put($node, $uri, $params := ()), whose call the static rules treat as updating (XUST0001 as for any update). Its value is one update primitive upd:put, the node as target and the URI as parameter: FOUP0001 for a node that is not a document or element (6.1 leaves other kinds implementation-defined), FOUP0002 for a $uri with a character no URI or IRI reference has or that does not resolve against the static base URI to an absolute URI. Application checks XUDY0031 (two puts, one URI) and XUDY0037 (a put in a copy-modify's modify clause) and changes no tree.

The host (include/sxml/xquery.h, additive): the update sink gets receive_put_document, called after every changed tree (3.2.2: upd:put last) with sxml_xquery_put_document (the absolute URI, the node as the other updates left it, the $params). The library never writes it (); NULL makes a query that calls fn:put fail with FOUP0002 before any tree is handed over. The node of a put on the root of a changed tree is the new root; a put on a node inside a changed tree gets the node as it was (node identity across a rebuild is not kept, ).

Revalidation (3.1, 3.2.4 upd:revalidate): XUST0026 is gone; lax and strict are supported. Each rebuilt tree that a type-changing primitive marked (upd:removeType reaches its root) is validated as "validate lax|strict { $top }" does, with sxml_schema_validate_node () and the in-scope schemas (the schema declaring the root element; for lax the first without one; XQDY0061, XQDY0084, XQDY0027), and its validated copy is the updated tree. The mode is the main module's for the query and the module's for copy-modify (modify-copies takes it as a third argument). sxml's initial revalidation mode stays skip: the static context table of 3.1 lets an implementation overwrite lax.

Copies (5.6 step 1.2; XQuery 3.1, 3.9.1.3): a copy-modify copy is untyped whatever the construction mode, and copies made untyped drop is-id and is-idrefs except for xml:id attributes. tree.h (frozen, ) gets one additive field, sxml_copy_request.strips_identity; false, the old behaviour, is what XSLT needs (validation="strip" and input-type-annotations="strip" keep is-id, copy-5034 and strip-type-annotations-021). The update application sets it for its copies. XQuery's own node constructors under construction strip still keep is-id (src/evaluator_construct.c has no language flag): left.
The updating return clause (XQUF 4.0 draft, copy modify): a copy-modify whose return clause is updating is updating, its pending update list the return clause's; 3.0's XUST0001 there is gone.

QT4 driver: revalidation lax and strict are supported; what fn:put stores is serialized, parsed again and added to the test case's available documents at its URI (no file is written), and assertions see the available documents.

Left: XUDY0038 for a simple dynamic call of an updating function item (no QT4 test; the one place is the evaluator's dynamic call); two cases where validating an element root checks IDREFs against its IDs (cvc-id.1) and the tests expect no such check (removeType-valskip-repnode-006, revalidate-valtrans-ins-002); six propagateNamespace cases whose expected XML has other whitespace than their queries make under boundary-space preserve (the suite's error: assert-xml compares canonical forms, kept strict); 27 staticTyping.
